name: shotproof
description: Screenshot to code for Claude Code and Codex: turn a screenshot into matching HTML + CSS or React + Tailwind with no API key, using the agent's own model, then render, score (SSIM) and fix until it matches. Convert an image to HTML, recreate a UI, clone a landing page or match a design; includes a locked-down private client-proof mode.

interface.shortDescription: Screenshot to HTML or React + Tailwind, scored and fixed until it matches
defaultPrompt: Turn this screenshot into a single HTML file and verify it matches.
